name: io.github.ni-c/wikijs-mcp
title: Wiki.js
description: Search, read and edit Wiki.js pages, and manage its assets, users, groups and comments

environmentVariables.name: WIKIJS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Wiki.js instance, e.g. https://wiki.example.com

environmentVariables.name: WIKIJS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API key from Administration → API Access. WIKIJS_API_KEY is accepted as an alias

environmentVariables.name: WIKIJS_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: Locale assumed by page tools that are not given one; part of a page's identity (default: en)

environmentVariables.name: WIKIJS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: WIKIJS_ALLOWED_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated page path prefixes the write tools are confined to, matched by path segment

environmentVariables.name: WIKIJS_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)

environmentVariables.name: WIKIJS_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever the allow list left

environmentVariables.name: WIKIJS_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate from a self-hosted instance (default: false)
